c.h: Depicts a tree with paper mulberry leaves. Original form of 楮.

casualty; victim; those injured and wounded

c.h: 忄 is a component form of 心.

情.o: Phonosemantic compound. 忄 represents the meaning and 青 represents the sound.

If you tell this to her, she will definitely go mad.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

清.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 青 represents the sound.

Zhè jù huà de dàolǐ nǐ yīnggāi qīngchǔ.

Quánbù qīngchú.

Xuéxí hànyǔ fāyīn yīdìng yào fēn qīngchǔ diàolèi.

He has an illess today.

Yīshēng zài gěi bìngrén kànbìng.

Tā niánshì yǐ gāo, yòu bèi duōzhǒng jíbìng kùnrǎo.
He is advanced in years and troubled by various diseases.

装.o: Phonosemantic compound. 衣 represents the meaning and 壮 represents the sound. Simplified form of 裝.
w: to install; to erect; to fix
to decorate; interior decoration; to fit up

Tā jiǎzhuāng shì xuéshēng.
She pretended to be a student.
这家服装店选择太多了。
Zhè jiā fúzhuāngdiàn xuǎnzé tài duō le.
This clothing store has too many choices.

c.h: 阝 is a component form of 阜.

When I go to his place I always feel excited and worried in equal measure.

There is only very little bread and biscuits.

久.o: Depicts an arrow nock. The nock is the part of an arrow that is held against the bowstring before being launched. Same origin as 氒. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.

not long (after); before too long; soon

Zhè tiáo hé de shuǐ hěn qiǎn.

Xiàtiān wǒ xǐhuan chuān qiǎnsè de yīfu.
